title: Host has seen Jacobs' DD214
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Host has seen Jacobs' DD214, about 1964 at Vandenberg Space Force Base, California, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: By the way, I've seen Bob Jacobs' DD214. He definitely worked at Vandenberg.

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says he has personally seen the DD214 of a man named Bob Jacobs. A DD214 is the paper the US military gives people when they leave service, listing where they served. Michels says it shows Jacobs really worked at Vandenberg, a military base in California, around 1964, which matters because it would back up Jacobs' own account of what he says he saw there.
